title: MAVLink Serializer
text: Serialize messages of MAVLink packet by converting Simulink nonvirtual bus to uint8 data stream, 1 input, 2 outputs; {MAVLink dialect source} sets the source for specifying the MAVLink message definition Select from standard MAVLink, {MAVLink dialect} sets the message definition to parse for MAVLink messages, {MAVLink version} sets the mAVLink protocol version and {MAVLink Message type} sets the mAVLink message. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Length
ports.summary: Length of the serialized data scalar

params.name: MAVLink dialect source
params.values: Source for specifying the MAVLink message definition Select from standard MAVLink dialects (default) | Specify your own

params.name: MAVLink dialect
params.values: Message definition to parse for MAVLink messages common.xml (default) | string
